title: IMB Mid-Year Report: Somalia Is the Outlier in an Otherwise Record-Low Year for Global Piracy
detail: The International Maritime Bureau's first-half 2026 report found global piracy at a 34-year low, but Somalia bucking the trend: 27 vessels boarded January-June, 5 hijacked, 3 fired upon and 3 attempted attacks, with Somali pirates accounting for 94% of hostages taken worldwide in the period. IMB Director Michael Howlett urged continued vigilance in the region even as incident rates fell everywhere else.

media.caption: Xinhua (Jul 2026): IMB mid-year report — Somalia piracy bucks global downward trend

title: WHO Appeals for $6.42M to Sustain Health and Nutrition Services in Somalia, Sudan, Djibouti
detail: The WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean appealed for US$6.42 million to sustain health and nutrition services across Somalia, Sudan and Djibouti — part of a broader $25.4 million Greater Horn of Africa response — funding disease surveillance and outbreak detection, nutrition screening and stabilization-centre referral, and medical supply pre-positioning amid the region's compounding humanitarian emergencies.

media.caption: WHO EMRO (Jul 9, 2026): Appeal for $6.42M to sustain health and nutrition services across Somalia, Sudan, Djibouti
